newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines January load factor up.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines January load factor up.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines Monday said its systemwide load factor in January rose to 66 percent from 63.6 percent one year ago.
The carrier said revenue passenger miles grew by six percent to 8.5 million from 7.9 million last year, while available seat miles rose to 12.8 million from 12.5 million in January 1996.
Domestic traffic increased by nine percent on a 3.2 percent rise in capacity, while International traffic increased 6.1 percent on a 0.2 percent capacity increase.
